Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks for a great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the trial: 

Summary:
- Use case: clinician summarization + triage for inbound patient messages (primary focus: reduce triage time for 1st-line nurses).
- Data scope: de-identified message headers + full patient messages for the POC; we will not retain patient PII beyond the trial window.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in avg triage time (baseline 6.5min), 95% precision on triage suggestions for critical messages, and clinician NPS >= 7.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) 3-week trial (1-week integration + 2-week evaluation).
2) Redwood will provide a dedicated trial endpoint and a small reserved pool for predictable latency.
3) We'll run a controlled batch of ~2,500 messages through the pipeline and measure throughput, latency, and quality vs your baseline.
4) Success criteria and evaluation checklist attached.

Owners:
- Redwood SE lead: Marcus Lin (technical integration, SLO monitoring)
- Redwood AE: me (Marissa) for success criteria, exec alignment, and contract handoff
- Acme SE: Tom Richards (data ingestion and validation)

Next steps:
- Marcus to send integration checklist and sample ingestion configs by EOD Wed (05/05).
- Emily/Tom to confirm data access windows and an internal security contact for a brief checklist review.
- Propose final readout + exec decision review w/ leadership on or around May 12th — please share availability.

Attachments: evaluation_checklist.xlsx, redwood_poc_scope_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attached is the integration checklist and a sample ingestion config (JSON stub) you can share with your infra team. Key technical notes: 
- We'll use a short-lived S3 presigned ingestion path for the initial batch and then switch to streaming ingestion for the evaluation phase.
